title: Articulated ragdoll and localized Gorn (host-verified)
summary: The rider ragdoll is rebuilt as XPBD articulated rigid bodies and Gorn now tears only the joint nearest the part that actually struck. This is a host-verified implementation checkpoint, not a public release; public deployment and verification are pending.
details: Ragdoll: 16 capsule segments from the decoded skeleton, solved with extended position-based dynamics (Muller et al. 2020). Knees and elbows are hinges that only flex the anatomical way; hips, shoulders, neck, spine, wrists and ankles use swing/twist cones. Contacts with friction act at the touching point, segments self-collide, and the body sleeps at rest. Adaptive 480/240 Hz substeps cost about 130 microseconds per 60 Hz frame natively while tumbling. Launch keeps 65% of pre-crash momentum.

Gorn: only the joint nearest the part that struck tears (hand/forearm: elbow, foot/shin: knee, upper arm: shoulder, thigh: hip, head: neck), earliest strike first, with escalating thresholds and at most four tears. Hard contacts leave wound splatter where they hit. Blood overhaul: arterial pulses from the stump, limb dribble, velocity-streaked droplets, splats stretched by impact angle and merged into stains, growing pools, smear trails and stump caps, drawn in one instanced draw with bounded pools (120 droplets, 64 splats). ATV breakaway follows the recorded contact point: nearest wheels for moderate hits, nearby parts for severe hits, and everything at 80 ft/s or more, with pieces flying away from the hit.

Discoveries: solver-impulse joint stress proved too noisy to drive dismemberment, so contact approach speed is used instead. The native wreck hands the rider over at only about 17 ft/s after a roughly 62 ft/s crash.

Verification (host only): make check passed (392 core Rust tests including the new ragdoll, gore and crash gates, 151 JS tests, formatting, strict Clippy); make verify passed. The Gorn browser gate passed on Caribou with 1,019 + 102 exactly paired enhanced/Off gameplay and camera steps, 3 ATV parts near the contact, a 41 ft/s rider strike, exactly one torn joint (right knee), two stump caps, no stretched triangles and an intact recovery. Female ATV26 and MX rider crashes ran without errors. Screenshot: Chromium/Metal 1280x844 at the moment of the severe Caribou impact, showing the right-knee tear with arterial spray and velocity-streaked droplets and two ATV wheels broken away. A second host capture shortly afterward showed the rider lying naturally on the snow with no limbs bent the wrong way and a blood splat trail around the body; it is not attached to this entry.
limitation: Host-only; not publicly deployed or verified yet. Body contacts are terrain-only (no trees, rocks or ATV), the local player only is simulated, and native recovery ends the scene after about 2-3 s. Motorcycles have no contact point, so their breakaway stays severity-based. The current route no longer produces an airborne bailout or 22 ft separation (also on production). The MX rider shows a pre-existing black back patch (also on production). Physical phones are unverified.
caption: Severe Gorn crash on Caribou: the rider's right knee tears at impact with an arterial spray and velocity-streaked droplets, and two ATV wheels near the contact have broken away. Host capture, Chromium/Metal 1280x844.
